text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — Q2 hosted API roadmap sync. Need to lock OKRs + scope for chat / completions / embeddings / rerank. Customer asks + launch criteria in this thread. Can everyone drop constraints + must-haves by EOD tomorrow?

Matt: +1. My top ask: embeddings latency for vector search customers. We should target p95 < 120ms for small vectors.

Kevin: rerank team: blocked on evaluation infra. Need 2 weeks to wire up batch eval + human review workflow. Otherwise we can only ship a narrow v1.

Jordan: infra constraints: Dedicated pools can handle throughput, but hosted single-tenant latency spikes when concurrency > 250 req/s for long sequences. If we push streaming + function-calling we need autoscale smoothing.

Sara: from product-ux: streaming and function-calling UX expectations need parity with chat. If we ship streaming for chat but not completions, customers will be confused. Recommend aligning streaming rollout across chat/completions.

Emily: CS input — QuickTax and DataSift both asked for embeddings SLA (300ms p95) and a batch-rerank endpoint. QuickTax is willing to sign a reserved capacity deal if we can commit to latency and data isolation.

Priya: Noted. Let's separate must-haves vs nice-to-haves. Proposed must-haves for Hosted API v1 (shortlist):
```
- Embeddings: p95 latency target & quantization profile validated on top-5 customers
- Chat: streaming + function calling parity; doc for fallback behaviors
- Rerank: basic batch endpoint + eval harness for quality checks
- SLAs: soft latency SLOs for hosted tier; enterprise SLO for reserved customers
- Observability: per-route token cost + latency breakdown in console
```

Matt: For embeddings perf, are we comfortable with 8-bit quantization as default? Tradeoff on recall. We should add an A/B eval to guard quality.

Kevin: @Matt agree. Eval harness should include downstream search metric (mrr@10 or ndcg). I'll scope ETL + labeled testset work. Need data-science help to pick metrics.

Sara: UX asks: if we do A/B, ensure customers can opt-out of quantization per API key. Config UI + API flag.

Jordan: Ops note: autoscale smoothing should be config-controlled per-customer to prevent noisy neighbor regressions. Also, caching prefixes for chat can cut token cost but changes latency profile.

Priya: Launch criteria proposal (quick checklist) — want feedback: 
```
- Quality: no regression > 2% on core evals for embeddings/chat vs baseline
- Latency: hosted p95 within targets for 90% of traffic patterns
- Cost: unit token cost <= target bucket for hosted tier
- Reliability: rollback policy + canary + fallback model in runtime
- Observability: dashboards + alerting for regressions + eval-runbook
```

Emily: QuickTax: if you can promise enterprise SLO + data isolation we can convert trial to reserved within 30 days. Pinging Sales for pricing.

Matt: Implementation notes: we'll need kernel tweaks for kv-cache eviction to keep chat latency stable under high concurrency. Estimated 3 sprint work.

Kevin: Rerank v1 scope: batch-only, single-model pipeline, offline eval. Rerank v2 later will be streaming and multi-model. Keep v1 narrow so we can meet Q2.

Priya: Tradeoffs: we can either rush broad feature coverage (streaming across all endpoints) or do narrower high-quality launches (embeddings + rerank batch + chat streaming). I vote for narrower high-quality.

Sara: Agree, narrower + configurable flags for advanced customers. Reduces UX surface.

Jordan: Timeline ask: if we go narrow, infra can deliver within 6 weeks for embeddings perf and 4 weeks for rerank batch. Streaming across chat/completions is 8+ weeks.

Priya: Decision: narrow Q2 slice — prioritize embeddings perf (p95 target) + chat streaming + rerank batch v1. Add quantization A/B with opt-out flag. Create OKRs from that stack.

Matt: Will draft engineering acceptance criteria and breakdown by sprint.

Kevin: I'll start the eval harness ticket and ping DS for metrics.

Sara: I'll draft the UX flag flow and a short API schema for opt-out.

Emily: I'll push the QuickTax pre-signed contract thread and capture SLA ask.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline note: "canary window set to 15m, auto-rollback on error-rate > 1%"

Priya: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Matt, Kevin, Sara — can you post concrete tickets by EOD Fri? I'll turn this into a PRD + OKRs doc next week. :thumbsup:
